evals.prompt: Our checkout page looks inconsistent with the rest of the app. Review it and clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Should select the checkout surface, trace its rendered path through compositions, tokens and styles, verify each problem against design evidence, and write self-contained plans under design-plans/ without touching product source.
assertions: Selects one coherent surface (checkout) instead of synthesizing the whole repo
Traces the rendered path through layouts, compositions and resolved tokens
Verifies findings against design evidence rather than asserting drift by name similarity
Creates or edits files only under design-plans/

evals.prompt: Just apply the fixes to the checkout directly, I trust your judgment.
evals.expected_output: Should decline to modify product source, explain the read-only boundary, and offer the written plans for another agent to execute after the user selects changes.
assertions: Declines to modify product source directly
Writes plans only for changes the user selects

evals.prompt: The dashboard uses a slightly different card radius than the settings page. Is that design-system drift?
evals.expected_output: Should prove or disprove the connection through rendering, imports, props, resolved config or generated artifacts — shared names or proximity alone must not count as drift.
assertions: Requires proof through rendering, imports, props or resolved config
Rejects shared names alone as evidence of drift
Rejects repository proximity alone as evidence
Prefers no finding over an unsupported one
